The "'''Pulverizer'''" was a [[rocket pod]] manufactured by [[Elsinore-Cordova Engineering]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Designed to destroy enemy objectives and to be loaded onto [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] in large quantities, Pulverizers and other rocket pods lacked guidance systems.<ref name="Starfighter" />
